claim.claim-text: 1. A pumped heat energy storage ("PHES") system (1005) comprising:

a charge-mode working fluid path arranged to circulate a working fluid through, in sequence, the first RTM system, the HHX system, the RHX system, the second RTM system, the CHX system, the RHX system, and back to the first RTM system, and a generation-mode working fluid path arranged to circulate the working fluid through, in sequence, the second RTM system, the RHX system, the HHX system, the first RTM, the RHX system, the CHX system, and back to the second RTM system.
2. The PHES system of claim 1, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises:

a first power transmission system (802) rotationally coupled to the first RTM and coupled to the third RTM via a first clutch (845), and a second power transmission system (802) coupled to the second RTM via a second clutch (835) and rotationally coupled to the fourth RTM.

3. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the reversible powertrain further comprises one or more isolation valves (834) operable to fluidly connect the second RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the second RTM from the working fluid loop.
4. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the second RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
5. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the second RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

6. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the reversible powertrain further comprises one or more isolation valves (844) operable to fluidly connect the third RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the third RTM from the working fluid loop.
7. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the third RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
8. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein the third RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

9. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the fourth RTM is configured to act as a compressor and the first RTM and second RTM are configured to act as turbines.

10. The PHES system of claim 2, wherein, in the charge mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the first RTM and the second RTM are configured to act as compressors and the fourth RTM is configured to act as a turbine.
11. The PHES system of claim 1,
wherein the first RTM system further comprises a fifth RTM (850-3),and wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises:

a first power transmission system (802) rotationally coupled to the first RTM and coupled to the third RTM via a first clutch (845), a second power transmission system (802) coupled to the second RTM via a second clutch (835) and rotationally coupled to the fourth RTM, and a third power transmission system (802) rotationally coupled to the fifth RTM.

12. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises one or more isolation valves (834) operable to fluidly connect the second RTM and the fifth RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the second RTM and the fifth RTM from the working fluid loop.
13. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the second RTM and the fifth RTM are fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
14. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the second RTM and the fifth RTM are fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

15. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises one or more isolation valves (844) operable to fluidly connect the third RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the third RTM from the working fluid loop.
16. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the third RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
17. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein the third RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

18. The PHES system of claim 11, wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the fourth RTM is configured to act as a compressor and the first RTM and the second RTM are configured to act as turbines.
19. The PHES system of claim 18, wherein the third power transmission system is not configured to supply power to the fifth RTM.

20. The PHES system of claim 19, wherein, in the charge mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the charge mode configuration, the first RTM, the second RTM, and the fifth RTM are configured to act as compressors and the fourth RTM is configured to act as a turbine.
21. The PHES system of claim 20, wherein the third power transmission system is configured to supply power to the fifth RTM.
22. The PHES system of claim 1, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises:

a power transmission system (802) rotationally coupled to the first RTM and rotationally coupled to the third RTM, a first clutch (845) that couples the third RTM and the fourth RTM, and a second clutch (835) that couples the first RTM and the second RTM.

23. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises one or more isolation valves (834) operable to fluidly connect the second RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the second RTM from the working fluid loop.
24. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the second RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
25. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the second RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

26. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the reversible powertrain system further comprises one or more isolation valves (844) operable to fluidly connect the fourth RTM to the working fluid loop and to fluidly disconnect the fourth RTM from the working fluid loop.
27. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the fourth RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid bypass loop.
28. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein the fourth RTM is fluidly connected to a working fluid recirculation loop.

29. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the generation mode configuration, the third RTM is configured to act as a compressor and the first RTM and the second RTM are configured to act as turbines.

30. The PHES system of claim 22, wherein, in the charge mode configuration, the first clutch is configured to disengage and the second clutch is configured to engage, and wherein, in the charge mode configuration, the first RTM and second RTM are configured to act as compressors and the third RTM is configured to act as a turbine.
